raw_response: {"diagnosis": "The silver_transactions step ignores the currency column, so 85 EUR-denominated rows are summed as if they were USD in every gold table. raw_fx_rates holds a single EUR to USD rate (1.25, as_of 2026-01-01), and every currency in raw_transactions has a rate, so amounts can be converted to USD in silver.", "decision": "fix", "confidence": 0.8, "pre_sql": [], "step_overrides": {"silver_transactions": "CREATE OR REPLACE TABLE silver_transactions AS SELECT CAST(t.txn_id AS BIGINT) AS txn_id, t.customer_id, CAST(t.merchant_id AS INTEGER) AS merchant_id, CAST(CAST(t.amount AS DOUBLE) * f.rate_to_usd AS DECIMAL(12,2)) AS amount, CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS txn_ts, CAST(CAST(t.txn_ts AS TIMESTAMP) AS DATE) AS txn_date FROM raw_transactions t JOIN raw_fx_rates f ON t.currency = f.currency WHERE t.status = 'POSTED';"}}
